title: Merge two sorted linked lists
prompt: a and b are the heads of two linked lists, each sorted from smallest to largest. Join their nodes into one sorted list and return its head. Either list may be null.
hints: At each step, which two nodes are the only candidates for the next node of the result?
Keep a tail for the result. Attach the smaller of the two front nodes, and move forward in the list it came from.
When one list runs out, attach the whole of the other. A temporary first node saves a special case for the head.
checkLabels: Two empty lists give an empty list.
One empty list gives the other.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Stops when one list runs out and drops the rest of the other.
Returns nothing when either list is empty, instead of returning the other list.

feedback: Trace the first check by hand, drawing the tail after each step. Then ask what happens to the nodes left in the longer list.
